name: 🍓 Greek Yogurt Parfaits
tagline: Layers of Nounos vanilla yogurt, berries and crunchy granola. Fancy-looking, five minutes.

steps.text: Slice the strawberries and rinse the blueberries.
In 4 glasses or jars: a big spoon of yogurt, then berries, then a sprinkle of granola.
Repeat the layers, ending with berries on top.
Add the last of the granola right before eating so it stays crunchy.

kid_jobs.job: Build your own parfait in a clear glass

chef_tip: Keep the granola out until the last second. For school-morning jars, pack it in a little cup on the side.
make_ahead: Layer yogurt and fruit in jars the night before; add granola in the morning.
leftovers: Berries going soft? Blend them into the Power Protein Smoothie.

game_plan.what: Kids layer yogurt and berries in jars; lids on, into the fridge.
Slice strawberries if not done; rinse blueberries.
Granola on top so it stays crunchy.
Grab a jar and a spoon.
